name: @runic-artifex/svelte
description: Svelte 5 Application Views helpers for Runic

scripts.clean: bun -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build: bun run --bun clean && svelte-package -i src -o dist
scripts.test: bun run --bun build && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && vitest run test/use-view.svelte.test.ts test/glue.svelte.test.ts test/use-operation.svelte.test.ts test/use-latest-operation.svelte.test.ts test/lifecycle.svelte.test.ts test/use-bridge-connection.svelte.test.ts test/use-menu-bar.svelte.test.ts test/use-text-field.svelte.test.ts test/use-field.svelte.test.ts test/text-field.browser.test.ts test/field.browser.test.ts
